API_accounting.attempts: Reserve before API entry and token work before loops; count return/ownership/seen results immediately before deadline/logging. Never infer a return or retry a pending creation/free.
API_accounting.derived_counts: Let D=sum document N, P=sum unique selected take_tokens, A=document+prefix ordinary attempts, R=ordinary accepted, Z=number of samplers reaching all-token completion, E=observed EOGcount. tokenize<=156; piece<=2D; sampler init/free=78+U when allQCgood; accept=R<=D+P; apply=A+Z*E<=D+P+(78+U)*E; EOGenumeration=nv.
API_accounting.document_tokenizer: At most2calls per78eligible docs; false/false add-special/parse-special. Retry only the initial negative required-size convention, once, within per-case cap; record changed/invalid sizing as unknown QC.
API_accounting.interrupted_or_deadline: No new work after interruption/work cutoff. Mandatory safe known-owned cleanup may bypass cooperative work tick but stays under external120s/caps; nonreturn/late cleanup veto complete profile.
API_accounting.pieces: At most2calls per original document token with counted bytes and bounded returned size<=B; no per-prefix piece/tokenizer calls.
API_accounting.sampler_expectation: 78+U only for complete allQCgood run, U unique selected boundaries<=4. Never copy old190 or treat known unavailable classes as observed prefix rejections.
API_accounting.scope: Explicit own bridge export calls only, not DLL-internal/OS/GPU/I/O/inference absence.
API_accounting.singleton: Apply to one ordinary candidate then accept only admitted ordinary IDs; stop that sampler at first rejection but retain entire precomputed ledger. If all admitted, query every EOG on unchanged state, never accept EOG.
API_accounting.stage_schedule: Exact source-derived API deltas required at every setup/before-case/result/coverage/prefix/cleanup frame. A typed-version no-backend/model claim requires corresponding counters0, not monotonicity alone.
API_accounting.unknown_cleanup: Unknown sampler init/free blocks dependent model/backend cleanup; unknown model load/free blocks backend teardown. Clear actionable owned pointer at once-only release reservation; retain primary+secondary failures. No automatic retry.
